findings.evidence: `rg -n "MinusFiveGalois|PrimeDiscriminantGaloisGroup" code/TauCeti/NumberTheory/Multiquadratic -g '*.lean'` shows `PrimeDiscriminantGaloisGroup.lean:8:public import ...MinusFiveGalois`, while the file’s main declarations are the general `galoisGroupEquivPrimeDiscriminantRadicands` and `card_aut_adjoin_roots_primeDiscriminantRadicands`.
findings.fix: Remove `public import TauCeti.NumberTheory.Multiquadratic.MinusFiveGalois` from this generic file; keep `MinusFiveGalois` as a separate worked-example module or import it only from an examples/aggregate module if one is needed.
findings.issue: The generic `PrimeDiscriminantGaloisGroup` module publicly imports the special-case `MinusFiveGalois`, so users importing the general prime-discriminant Galois API also get and depend on the concrete `ℚ(i, √5)` CM example.

summary: The previous duplicated `-21` setup has been shared, but one generic prime-discriminant module now depends publicly on a concrete `-5` example module, which puts the API at the wrong level.
